question: Does the current local SAM worker process the previously inspected real Objectron recordings and produce traceable image-space observations?
decision: Identify current-worker regressions and remaining tracking limitations before collecting filmed FlowBlock takes or measuring creator benefit.
unit: One first-five-second trim of one public mobile recording, one local MPS execution. Frames within a recording are dependent.
membership: Freeze all eight eligible recordings from the retained ten-sequence Objectron convenience sample. Preserve the two original exclusions. Any subset must be declared before execution.
exposure: These recordings were inspected in the earlier development diagnostic. A fresh execution is not fresh held-out evidence.
treatment: Pinned SAM 2.1 Small, box prompt from the first projected 3D cuboid only; no later labels or corrected prompts supplied.
control: No causal control or treatment comparison. Previous receipts are retained for inspection, not scored as an independent sample.
runtime: Freeze hashes of executed adapter, worker pipeline/model/measurement/video modules, model manifest, runner and test/protocol; record installed ML package, Python and FFmpeg versions. Model initialization verifies source commit and checkpoint bytes. Job transport and telemetry modules are outside this direct-worker run.
timing: Preserve source presentation-timestamp mappings from the reviewed prepared inputs. Analyze at 15 fps; exclude the seeded frame from aggregates.

measures.completion: Completed recordings / all recordings frozen for execution, with failed, unattempted, excluded and not-selected rows separate.
measures.usable_fraction: Worker-visible observations with proxy measurements / all non-seed observations in completed recordings. The worker's review heuristics are not calibrated confidence or an accuracy judge.
measures.proxy_discrepancies: Equal-video means of conditional per-video projected-center frame-diagonal discrepancy, centroid containment, and width/height ratios. Publish contributing-video counts. Projected cuboids are not visible silhouettes.
measures.latency: Per-video processing includes decode, segmentation, measurement and evidence writes; excludes model initialization and queue time. Full local wall time includes model construction. Desktop MPS with CPU fallback does not establish CUDA or deployed service performance.

failures: One attempt per selected sequence. Stop on an infrastructure exception, preserve partial artifacts and unattempted rows, and refuse reuse of an execution-started directory. Uncertain or empty tracks are observations and do not trigger a replacement clip.
stop_gate: Reject input, executed-source, snapshot or installed-dependency drift before model initialization; flag drift after execution. No automatic retry, downloads, paid inference or remote deployment.
evidence_scope: public-dataset-tracking only. No filmed FlowBlock plan execution, visible-mask ground truth, creator judgment, correction benefit or time-to-usable-take outcome is measured.
rights: Retain Objectron C-UDA-1.0 agreement and attribution. Keep footage, annotations and rendered frames in ignored local artifacts; publish metadata-only summaries if requested.
reproduction: worker/.venv/bin/python training/experiments/field-validation/validate_real_footage.py freeze --output training/artifacts/field-validation-NEW; then the same command with run after inspecting freeze.json
publication: No remote publication by this runner. summary.json links per-video measurements and hashes the frozen inputs and executed implementation.
